BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC has purchased 213,205 ordinary shares on 17 August 2026 and 96,322 ordinary shares on 18 August 2026 as part of its $250 million share repurchase program. The purchases were made on the XLON trading venue, with prices ranging from 1,630.0000 pence to 1,657.0000 pence. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and following these transactions, the total number of issued ordinary shares will be 208,795,427, with the total voting rights remaining the same. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 24 August 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 17 August 2026 to 21 August 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Date within Disclosure Period Trading Venue Aggregate number of ordinary shares repurchased Lowest price paid(pence) Highest price paid (pence) Volume-weighted average price (pence) 17 August 2026 XLON 116,883 1,631.0000 1,649.0000 1,636.0933 18 August 2026 XLON 96,322 1,630.0000 1,657.0000 1,648.2528 The Company intends to cancel the repurchased shares. Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 13,091,026 ordinary shares at a total cost of £185,483,185.91. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 208,795,427 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 208,795,427.
